Lapse [BL]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Temporis/Potence
Only usable before range is determined.
[pot] This vampire gets +2 strength this round.
[tem] The opposing minion cannot maneuver this round.
[TEM] The opposing minion cannot strike during the initial strike phase
this round (other strike resolution effects are not affected).

I assume that at outferior potence, if I play 2 in a round, I have a
total of +4 strength? And if I played 6 (assuming I could pay), I would
have a total of +12 strength?

thank you,

news:3b28b4813d0c26c022c...@mygate.mailgate.org...


Even if a card doesn't say +x to something, each one exerts it's own effect.
In the case of Camarilla Threat you'd have to pay one pool for each
Camarilla Threat. However, note that some cards "set x to y", so cards like
Torn Signpost ( set base strength to 2/3 ) will not stack, each one sets x
to the same y ( assuming played at the same level etc ).
